title: Synthesis of mesoporous carbon from banana peels with silica gel 60 as the hard templates
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,4536-4545
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08322A, Paper

The synthesis of mesoporous carbon was successfully performed through solid–solid phase reaction employing banana peel powder as the carbon source and silica gel 60 (SG-60) as the hard template.
